## WF08 – SLA monitor
Every minute: time spent in the current status vs `SLA_*_MINUTES` (CRITICAL × `SLA_CRITICAL_FACTOR`).
One alert per RFQ per status episode (`alerts.dedupe_key`) – never repeated. `rfqs.sla_breached = true` is kept for reporting.
Manual run: `POST /webhook/ops/run-sla`.
